params.body:
Follow-up to #114. Opening a team member's row folded out a panel that repeated what the row already said (the plan, the role) and gave Account and Delete each a block of their own. A members list is a solved pattern: change the role in the row, keep what is done *to* an account one step away.

**Team rows**
- The role is a select in the Observatory column: Member, Editor, Admin, or Remove from the team. What the role may do is its tooltip, and the notice after a change says it in words.
- A team row no longer opens.
- At the end of each row a quiet "⋯" opens a menu, the same panel as the header's menus: Block this account (or Unblock), Delete this account in `hot`, and Send the invitation again for an invitation not yet accepted. Escape or a click elsewhere closes it.

**Asking first.** Block and Delete still ask first, now in one line under the row; Delete still wants the address typed back.

**Members of gentells.com** still open for what the row does not show (plan, trial, Observatory access, joining the team). Their Account and Delete blocks moved into the same row menu.

Builds on #114 (short role names and `ROLE_DOES`). Checked on a build with mock data at 1280 px: the row, the open menu, the delete line. Build and lint clean.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
params.title: Accounts: change a team member in their row, Block and Delete behind its menu
